name: personal-setup-routing
description: Unobserved contracts for personal setup ownership and human-facing command teaching.

evidenceRefs: User requested a focused plugin for amichne/shell-config.

cases.prompt: Manage my shell-config setup. The older notes say bare HOME, but the current config wrapper uses a separate Git directory and public worktree. Verify source and consumer ownership before editing.

observedRoute.summary: Unobserved scenario: historical bare-HOME instructions can be mistaken for current setup authority.
observedRoute.risk: An edit targets the wrong tree or stages private state.

allowedActions: Verify the current wrapper, exact origin, Git directory, worktree and core.bare before dependent writes.
Use tracked public paths and the existing link installer owner.
Preserve unrelated source changes, index entries and private overrides.
forbiddenActions: Recreate historical ~/.cfg or use it as an automatic fallback.
Bulk-stage HOME or recursively read private setup state.
Claim installed behavior from a source-only check.
cases.recoveryExpectation: Resolve the current owner from source and metadata; ambiguous authority stops dependent writes.
cases.productiveOutcome: Personal setup changes reach the verified public owner without changing unrelated private state.
verificationEvidence: The handoff names the verified source and consumer boundary.
A focused fixture check proves the edited installation or command invariant.
cases.notes: A new contract scenario, not an observed model routing result.

cases.prompt: Craft a parameterized personal shell utility from reusable building blocks. Include Zsh completion and --teach with exact command source, current directory, recent-command summaries and an optional question.

observedRoute.summary: Unobserved scenario: personal tool authoring can route only to agent-facing CLI design and omit contextual human teaching.
observedRoute.risk: The tool lacks the requested composition, completions or source-backed teaching contract.

allowedActions: Reuse cohesive parsing, selection, effect and presentation owners.
Generate offline completion from authoritative option definitions.
Supply explicit complete source files, bounded directory names, history summaries and a provided or inferred question to --teach.
Prove preview and success/failure transport with a deterministic adapter.
forbiddenActions: Invent options or infer complete implementation from a thin launcher.
Read raw private history databases to fill missing parent-shell context.
Present adapter tests as observed model guidance quality.
cases.recoveryExpectation: Add only the missing personal-tool contract and report unavailable history or incomplete source explicitly.
cases.productiveOutcome: The user receives a composable tool with accurate discoverability and context-aware advice grounded in its implementation.
verificationEvidence: Normal operation, help, completion and teach preview pass focused checks.
Source and assistant failure paths are typed and nonzero.
cases.notes: New acceptance definition; model routing and guidance quality remain unobserved.
